title: Viral glycosyltransferase Section 1 structural mining and coarse clustering: software
description: Section 1 computational reproducibility evidence supporting Figure 1 and Supplementary Figures 1–4 of the viral glycosyltransferase manuscript. The downstream baseline consists of 1,727 structures retrieved through the original 447-residue MGAT2 Foldseek search. Structure identities and downstream results are independently verified. The package preserves historical sources and distinguishes reconstructed figure code and audit-only validation. Numerical evidence covers 7/7 GT-entry recovery in a 483-entry spike cluster, 114 representative classifications, 63 small-cluster coherence analyses and 646 singleton QC records. The separate truncated GT-A core files are a non-blocking historical limitation; no independent search-output equivalence is asserted. Unconfirmed institutional AF3 models, model-derived structural database payloads and the qualitative control structure plate are excluded; numerical results remain archived. Creator: Lan Na, University of Georgia, ORCID 0000-0003-2788-6123. See licenses, exclusions, manifests and reproducibility limitations in the files.
